presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: six near-maximum turns (52–57 characters) must all wrap onto ONE turn rail along the top wall next to the witness box; at 9:16 and 1:1 the rail cannot hold them at the 16 px floor, so the card texts are cut and the room shrinks. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px at every ratio): text column and bands of 2–4 columns, room width searched with narrower card wrapping, room scales, table beside or below the witness box, label/badge orders. Rendered BEFORE (production/scratch/hearings-03/capmeasure.mjs, hold, 1080p): 16:9 16.4 px / people 102.6 px; 9:16 16.4 / 49.2 with card-text and people-small; 1:1 16.4 / 48.9 with card-text and people-small. AFTER the cap (five turns of 30–36 characters; participants, exhibits, form wording, captions and notes unchanged): 16:9 17.1 / 113.8; 9:16 22.5 / 63.5; 1:1 16.4 / 63.5; no problems. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline (four turns of 16–30 characters). Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-03/LAW-0289.presets.precap.json.
